stories.title: Who's public enemy No. 1? The biggest villain of every Power 4 college football team
stories.summary: Every fanbase has someone it absolutely loves to hate. Here's our list and the stories behind the fury.

stories.title: College football's most hated villains of all time
stories.summary: No one fuels fans' ire more than Lane Kiffin these days, but is he the best pot-stirrer of all time?

stories.title: Reid: Mahomes unlikely for preseason opener
stories.summary: Although Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes has participated in every part of training camp, coach Andy Reid acknowledged Friday that he will likely not have him play in the team's preseason opener next week against the Rams.

stories.title: Harden's misdemeanor gun charge dismissed
stories.summary: A misdemeanor gun charge against All-Star Cleveland Cavaliers guard James Harden in Texas has been dismissed.

stories.title: WR Diggs ups claim: Best No. 1 'in my heart'
stories.summary: Stefon Diggs has changed teams for the third time in three years, but that hasn't dented his confidence.
